parts.text: The first reference photo sets the sculpting style, clay finish, lighting and camera framing. The second reference photo is the character: keep the exact same face sculpt and head proportions. Change only what this description says: Photograph of a hand-sculpted stop-motion claymation figure, matte plasticine with fingerprints, tool marks and pressed texture, soft studio lighting, highly detailed, in exactly the style of the reference photos. A grotesque disfigured old man with an oversized bobble head, mottled skin with age spots, small sunken bloodshot eyes in swollen red-rimmed lids, a large ear with a fat hanging lobe, thick neck, hunched broad shoulders, head turned three-quarters toward the viewer's right. Head type: a cranium split by a deep stitched crease down the middle, swollen lobes either side, pink flesh-toned clay skin, bald crown with stringy grey clay hair tufts above the ears, raised grey clay wrinkle ridges on the forehead, his visible ear is mostly torn away, only a ragged bloody stump of ear left with jagged torn edges and dried blood. A cracked greasepaint killer clown face with green diamond eye paint, a red bulb nose, a ragged fanged grin dripping blood and wild orange hair puffs. Wearing a baggy bloody harlequin clown suit with a ruffled collar and pom-pom buttons, a worn leather tool belt with rusty tools and pouches, his right fist grips a gleaming golden machete dripping blood, a giant red-and-cream striped circus mallet slung behind his back. A toxic wasteland with glowing green puddles, rusted leaking barrels and a smoky orange sky, sculpted as a miniature claymation diorama in matte plasticine, softly out of focus behind him, no signs or lettering. FACING: exactly like the first reference photo, his body is in three-quarter view and his head and face are turned about 45 degrees toward the RIGHT side of the image (the viewer's right), nose pointing right; never turned to the left side and never straight on. Three-quarter view from the hips up, whole head, mask and weapons inside the frame with a little space above the head, figure centred, square 1:1 composition. SCALE (the same for every figure in the series): the figure is the same size in the frame as in the first reference photo, the bobble head the same size relative to the body, and weapons true to scale with the hands, never oversized or tiny. His right hand grips the held weapon in a tight clenched fist seen from the back of the hand, knuckles toward the camera, palm hidden, the blade angled up and out; his other hand hangs open. Avoid: text, logo, letters, watermark, brand marks, sports team logo, red chevrons or triangles on the mask, full-face goalie mask covering the forehead and eyes, white screaming ghost mask, black hooded robe, pins in a grid, extra fingers, deformed hands, cropped head, photo of a real person, cartoon outline, flat 2D, face turned to the left, mirrored pose, long finger blades, clawed glove with four long knives, red and green striped sweater, brown fedora
